A '''battle''' occurred circa [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] between the fleets of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] and the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. It resulted in the death of [[Noira]], the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] of the Sorority, and ended the war between the two pirate groups.<ref name="MotPQ" />
